questions.q: Differentiate $y = x^2 e^{3x}$ with respect to $x$.
Find the derivative of $f(x) = x \ln x$ evaluated at $x = e$.
questions.answer: $f'(x) = 1\cdot \ln x + x\cdot\frac{1}{x} = \ln x + 1$. At $x = e$: $f'(e) = \ln e + 1 = 1 + 1 = 2$.

questions.q: The radius of a circular oil spill is increasing at $0.5 \text{ m/s}$. At what rate is the area increasing when the radius is $10 \text{ m}$?
A solid cylindrical metal rod of radius $r$ and length $h$ has fixed volume $V = 54\pi$. Express the surface area $S$ in terms of $r$ and find $r$ minimizing $S$.
questions.answer: $V = \pi r^2 h = 54\pi \Rightarrow h = 54/r^2$. $S = 2\pi r^2 + 2\pi r(54/r^2) = 2\pi r^2 + 108\pi/r$. $\frac{dS}{dr} = 4\pi r - 108\pi/r^2 = 0 \Rightarrow 4r^3 = 108 \Rightarrow r^3 = 27 \Rightarrow r = 3$.
